gloss: paternal side; father's side (of the family)

definitions.gloss: paternal side; father's side of the family
definitions.explanation: Refers to relatives, lineage, or characteristics coming from the father's side of the family. Used when distinguishing between maternal and paternal family lines.

examples.japanese: {父方|ちちかた}の{祖母|そぼ}に{会|あ}った。
{父方|ちちかた}の{親戚|しんせき}は{九州|きゅうしゅう}に{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Most of my paternal relatives live in Kyushu.

examples.japanese: {父方|ちちかた}の{家系|かけい}には{医者|いしゃ}が{多|おお}いと{聞|き}いている。
examples.english: I've heard that there are many doctors in my father's side of the family.

notes:
USAGE:
{父方|ちちかた} is used to specify the father's side when discussing family relationships, especially grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins. It is typically used as a modifier before a family term: {父方|ちちかた}の{祖父|そふ} (paternal grandfather), {父方|ちちかた}の{叔父|おじ} (paternal uncle).

CONTRAST:
{父方|ちちかた} vs. {母方|ははかた} (maternal side) — these form a natural pair for distinguishing which side of the family is being discussed.
